With an exceptional Brooklyn Heights location and classic co-op charm, this spacious one-bedroom home offers the best of both style and comfort. Set within a pet-friendly, full-service building, the apartment features a beautifully renovated kitchen and bath, generous proportions, and a bright, airy feel throughout.

The spacious living room is filled with natural light from oversized windows and has the loveliest of views overlooking the gardens of Joralemon Street and the architectural detail of nearby churches and townhouses. The layout is large enough to easily accommodate distinct living and dining areas.

The thoughtfully renovated kitchen features custom grey cabinetry (complete with lighted drawers!), stainless steel appliances, quartz counters and a herringbone tile backsplash. Efficiently designed, the kitchen offers abundant storage and great workspace.

Down the hall, adjacent to a large closet is the classically renovated windowed bathroom. A cast iron tub, marble black-and-white basketweave tile, classic white subway tile with black trim, and a pedestal sink create a look that is both fresh and timeless.

The bedroom, which offers the same lovely views as the living area, is remarkably spacious. Two large closets, complete with custom organization, span the room, while a cleverly tucked-away home office nook provides the perfect work-from-home setup without encroaching on the bedroom's generous space.

Throughout the apartment, dark-stained hardwood floors, high ceilings, and classic picture-frame moldings add warmth and character.

Located in a full-service elevator building, amenities include an on-site superintendent, part-time doorman, storage, and laundry room. The building is perfectly situated with easy access to the Promenade and Brooklyn Bridge Park, all major train lines, and the wonderful shops, cafes and restaurants of Montague Street and Atlantic Avenue.

Apartment 7D at 825 West End Avenue is a beautifully scaled Upper West Side prewar condominium currently configured as a spacious two bedroom, two-bathroom home with approximately 1,687 square feet and the flexibility to convert back to a three bedroom. Originally, a five room, the apartment has been opened into a grand four that offers exceptional living space and a sense of elbowroom rarely found today.

Located on the seventh floor with three exposures, the home enjoys abundant natural light and open sky views throughout the day. The windowed eat-in kitchen blends strong design and everyday functionality with custom lacquer cabinetry, full-size appliances, and a Bosch washer and dryer!

The primary suite is generously proportioned and entered through a dedicated dressing corridor lined with closets, creating both privacy and excellent storage. The enlarged windowed marble bathroom features a soaking tub and separate shower. The second bedroom is also well scaled and benefits from a substantial walk-in closet, offering storage capacity that is rarely found in prewar homes. It sits adjacent to a second windowed bath with an oversized marble shower.

Designed by renowned architect Emery Roth, 825 West End Avenue embodies the timeless appeal of classic Upper West Side architecture. Roth's work is celebrated for its thoughtful proportions, elegant detailing, and enduring construction, all of which are evident here through the apartment's gracious scale, soaring ceiling heights, and refined prewar character.

This pet-friendly full-service condominium offers a full-time door attendant, live-in superintendent, and an ideal location seconds from Riverside Park, the 1/2/3 subway lines, neighborhood restaurants, and everyday shopping.

Discover the space, light, and classic architecture that make Apartment 7D a standout Upper West Side home.

An Outdoor Oasis in Ridgewood

Welcome to Unit J1B at The Glenridge Mews Condominium, a rare garden-level home offering exceptional indoor–outdoor living. Tucked within the charming Mews section of the complex, this beautifully renovated 845 sq ft two-bedroom, one-bath residence features an extraordinary 500+ sq ft private patio—a true extension of the home and a standout feature rarely found in condominium living.

Measuring approximately 36’ x 14’, the patio is enclosed with wood privacy fencing and accented with Edison string lighting, creating a warm and inviting outdoor retreat. Whether you envision alfresco dining, summer gatherings, container gardening, or simply relaxing under the lights, this expansive space offers endless possibilities for enjoying your own private oasis.

Inside, the thoughtfully renovated interior offers a spacious living area with dining alcove and a modern kitchen equipped with stainless steel appliances. Two well-proportioned bedrooms provide comfortable living, complemented by an updated full bathroom. 

The home also features wide-plank flooring, a blend of stylish globe pendant and recessed lighting, five closets for excellent storage, in-unit washer and dryer, and efficient mini-split air conditioning for year-round comfort.

Adding to the home’s tranquility, every window overlooks the private patio and the beautifully landscaped Mews, where a lush garden setting includes flowering shrubs and mature trees such as dogwoods, holly, redbuds, and magnolias.

Offering rare private outdoor space, modern updates, and a peaceful garden setting, Unit J1B is a unique opportunity to enjoy condominium living with the feel of your own backyard retreat.

The Glenridge Mews Condominium is a pet friendly, 64-unit condo with a live-in super and fitness room. Conveniently located to Fresh Pond Rd and Myrtle Ave shopping and dining. Nearby local favorites include Arrigio’s, Dada, Oeg’s Cavalier, Good Days Cafe, Rolo's, Il Gigante, Hellbender, Nowadays, Evil Twin Brewery, Cassette, Pizzeria Panina, TV Eye, the Ridgewood YMCA and Joseph Mafera Park. Just 30 minutes to Manhattan by M or L subways or express bus QM24, QM25 and QM34.

Come see what all the buzz is about and make Ridgewood your home sweet home today!

Note: Property taxes shown include NYC co-op condo tax abatement for primary home owners. A coveted private parking space P35 is being sold separately for $35,000. Parking space has monthly cc $42.23 and taxes of $45.33.

Co-brokers always welcome. All showings by appointment including posted open house times.

KIBO Residences is inspired by the Japanese wabi-sabi design philosophy that expresses quiet luxurywhere beauty is found in imperfection, texture, and restraint rather than excess. Crafted in collaboration with award-winning interior design firm fws_work, the interiors embrace a thoughtful material palette that feels both timeless and deeply human. Lime-washed surfaces, original exposed brick, plaster walls, and layered materials are allowed to age, soften, and reveal their character over time, creating an atmosphere that feels calm, tactile, and enduring.

TH-A is a triplex townhouse offering a refined expression of warmth, volume, and materiality. Ceiling heights exceeding 10 feet and two dramatic 20-foot double-height atriums anchor the home, visually and spatially connecting all three levels. One atrium is articulated in textured, hand-finished cement, while the other is lined in MADERA European white oak wall and ceiling panels, creating a composed dialogue of contrast, depth, and light.

European white oak flooring extends throughout the residence, unifying the spaces with warmth and restraint. Interiors are anchored by custom millwork and a Fisher & Paykel kitchen appliance package, balancing artisanal craftsmanship with modern performance.

Bathrooms are finished in lime wash and appointed with heated floors, heated towel racks, and TOTO Washlet toilets, accented with RBW lighting, offering a serene, spa-like experience. Smart living is seamlessly integrated with a Nest smart home system, smart lock entry, and ButterflyMX virtual doorman system, while an in-unit washer and dryer add everyday ease.

TH-B is a refined townhouse retreatwhere architectural texture, thoughtful technology, and intentional design converge.

Perched high above the surrounding historic architecture of Union Square, Residence 93 at The Swannanoa is a bright and beautifully proportioned one-bedroom that captures the elegance of early New York apartment living.

Originally designed in 1898 by architect Gilbert A. Schellenger, The Swannanoa was part of a new generation of downtown residences created for professionals who wanted the light, scale, and architectural detail of townhouse living within a modern elevator building.

Inside the home, oversized windows frame the surrounding cast-iron and loft buildings that define this historic Union Square neighborhood, creating a viewscape that feels distinctly New York.

The gracious living room is filled with natural light and features high ceilings, original moldings, rich hardwood floors, and a classic cast-iron radiator. A wide architectural opening of sliding doors connects the living room to the bedroom beyond, creating the classic parlor-style layout that defined elegant turn-of-the-century apartments while allowing light to flow beautifully through the home.

The bedroom comfortably accommodates a king-size bed and enjoys three exposures, east, north and south for all day sunlight with an architectural backdrop.

The windowed kitchen is thoughtfully laid out with generous cabinetry, stone countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a comfortable dining nook, rare for homes of this scale in downtown Manhattan. With open sky and city views, natural light carries throughout the space.

The windowed bathroom retains its vintage charm with classic tilework and mosaic flooring.

Residents of The Swannanoa enjoy a prewar cooperative with a virtual doorman, elevator, live-in superintendent, laundry, storage (separate rental fee), and a beautifully restored lobby.

Just one block from Union Square's renowned farmers market, restaurants, and major subway lines (4/5/6/N/Q/R/W/L), the location offers seamless access to Greenwich Village, Flatiron District, and the East Village.

A timeless Union Square residence where historic architecture, natural light, and classic prewar proportions come together in one of downtown Manhattan's most vibrant neighborhoods. Represented by Decode Real Estate.
